test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GRAPES' is written as 'HQBOFR', and 'FACTOR' is written as ‘GZDSPQ’. How will 'LAYOUT' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• 'GRAPES' is written as 'HQBOFR'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e855acdf8ec4111eadea3358e5e980583a9ae25253066a45210e29bb75859fce.png] 

And

 
• 'FACTOR' is written as ‘GZDSPQ’.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76e19c4ebc3ec99bcee06f9f3ed725807f936c3b3f5ea42486a8463b3c89ffc9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'LAYOUT' will be written as :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b5c03f3d4413311c13d69ba6655c694c19c803f75f351622941e9bc59098389.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MZZNVS".**
